titel: Click Joints Pro, winkeltekst ronde 2 (B verbeterd met de zinnen van de rechters)
rol: You make 3D models in Blender and like to 3D print figures at home. You are browsing a Blender add-on store and read the title and first lines of each product page. Pick the add-on you would buy first this week.

ons.tekst:
Click Joints Pro - Poseable 3D Print Figures from Your Rig (Hinges with End Stops, Ball Joints, Fit Test Strip)

Rig in. Joints out.

Press one button and your rigged character becomes a printable, poseable figure: a hinge at every elbow and knee that stops where your rig stops, and a ball joint at the shoulders, hips and neck. You see how far each joint bends, in degrees, before you print. Already split your model with another tool? Put the 3D cursor on a knee and Click Joints Pro adds the joint right there.

Click Joints Pro - Poseable 3D Print Figures from Your Rig (Hinges with End Stops, Ball Joints, Fit Test Strip)

Rig in. Joints out.

Press one button and your rigged character (Rigify, Mixamo, Auto-Rig Pro and more) becomes a printable, poseable figure: a hinge at every elbow and knee that stops where your rig stops, and a ball joint at the shoulders, hips and neck. You see how far each joint bends, in degrees, before you print. Print the Fit test strip first and you know which clearance, from 0.10 to 0.30 mm, fits your printer, so joints are not loose or fused.

Cleave - Smart Model Split & Cut for 3D Printing with Connectors (Pegs, Dowel, Rod channel, Magnets, Ball Joints)

Too big to print? Split it.

A Blender add-on that splits big STL models along their natural joints, adds connectors that fit, from pegs to ball joints, and checks every piece against your resin or FDM printer.

CatPin

Split your 3D model with full control over every cut and connector.

Edit the setup at any time: quickly and easily. CatPin is also a great fit for dense AI-generated models. (As long as Blender can handle the mesh.)

Split-3DPrint

NEW UPDATE · V4: Automatic Tools, Socket, Extract Part & More

Press Automatic Detection and your model splits into its own parts, hair, head, arms, top, shorts, each ready to come off with its connector. Plus a new Socket cut that pulls a detail out as a plug, and three new connector options.
